chapter: Prison work songs and Lead Belly
title: Lead Belly at Camp A
summary: Welch served time with Lead Belly at Camp A in 1938 and says he only picked up paper in the yard.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: By the way, you said you knew Ladd Valley went down.
Yes, sir, I did. Where was that? I did time with him over at 8. At Camp A. Yes, sir. 1938. He left here in 1939.
And what did he do? Was he, I mean, doing the work?

Well, uh... Was he, uh... Uh, most of what he did is round on the yard. Pick up paper and stuff. The captain wouldn't let him do nothing but pick up paper and stuff on the yard. He was too old, huh? Yes, sir.
